name: skills
description: Portable agent skills, installable as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite prose so it is precise, readable, and naturally human. English by default; Czech, Slovak, Polish, German, and Ukrainian on request. Removes common AI-writing patterns.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Create branded diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG/PNG in 39 visual types, with brand onboarding and draw.io/Mermaid import.

plugins.name: test-discipline
plugins.description: Test hygiene for changed .spec and .test files, with severity-graded OK / FIX / DELETE / MISSING reviews.

plugins.name: write-prompt
plugins.description: Write, improve, or translate a prompt: repository context, model-specific guidance from official documentation, and a mandatory independent review.

plugins.name: video-proof
plugins.description: Present completed features through real browser footage with female English narration, bottom subtitles, change highlights, visible clicks, and verified build and Git safety.

plugins.name: orchestrator-claude
plugins.description: Run a task as an orchestrator over Claude subagents: a worker executes and, from fast up, a reviewer reviews; the mode (quick, fast, standard, comprehensive) chooses them. Use only when the user asks for /orchestrator-claude.

plugins.name: orchestrator-codex
plugins.description: Run a task as an orchestrator over Codex processes: a worker executes and, from fast up, a reviewer reviews; the mode (quick, fast, standard, comprehensive) chooses them. Use only when the user asks for /orchestrator-codex.

plugins.name: orchestrator-hybrid
plugins.description: Run a task as an orchestrator over a mixed pair: a Claude Opus worker implements and, from fast up, a Codex Sol reviewer reviews; the mode (quick, fast, standard, comprehensive) chooses the rest. Use only when the user asks for /orchestrator-hybrid.
